【原视频简介】
Authentic Organic Date Garden🌴 & Pure Honey Farming 🍯 in Local Arab Life 🐪

About this Video:
Embark on a fascinating journey through Madinah and beyond, starting with an insightful breakdown of the differences and rates between normal and organic dates (Khujoor) 🌴. Discover the ancient, historical travel routes stretching from Madinah to Al Ula 🗺️ before exploring a lush organic date garden right in the heart of the holy city 🍃. Experience the traditional Arabic lifestyle with a deep dive into authentic, pure honey farming inside desert tents 🍯, and wrap up the adventure with a warm, friendly lunch gathering and a heartwarming visit with a local friend, Hassan Break🍛.
